claim: The default quota is 20 gateway VPC endpoints per Region, and it is adjustable; you can create up to 255 gateway endpoints per VPC.
question: How many gateway VPC endpoints can you have per Region by default, and what is the per-VPC maximum?

values.spoken: two hundred fifty-five gateway endpoints per VPC

qualifiers.condition: You can create up to 255 gateway endpoints per VPC
